[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:381YE Winter]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>the Quartermaster General, Dan Brackensong, announced that the Imperial Guerdon for Winter 381 is to go to the following Armies:<br>the Quiet Step<br>the Summer Storm<br>the Hounds of Glory<br> the Wolves of War.<br><br><i>Approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies using the legal power to authorise targets of the Imperial Guerdon granted to them by the Senate

===Date===
* Winter 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* Owners of military units who support one of the announced armies will receive a share of the Imperial Guerdon.
